items.title: How one energy company uses CX to drive customer retention
items.summary: NRG Energy’s CX team owns the experience but can’t directly affect change. Instead, it works through internal partners to identify and address friction points.

items.title: NRG to sell 4.9 GW of gas plants to LS Power for $4B
items.summary: NRG Energy CEO Robert Gaudette said the sale values one 1.2-GW Texas gas plant at $1,400/kW, while NRG is “developing 1.5 GW of new natural gas generation in Texas” for just above $1,000/kW.

items.title: A $4 Billion Jolt: NRG Energy Powers Data Center Ambitions
items.summary: NRG Energy beat Q3 earnings estimates and struck a $4 billion deal to sell 4.9 gigawatts of gas plants to LS Power, funding debt reduction, buybacks, and a dividend increase.

items.title: NRG Q3 Earnings Call Focuses on Asset Sale and 2027 Outlook
items.summary: NRG unveils a $4 billion asset sale, expands share buybacks to $3 billion and sets 2027 earnings targets while advancing a major Texas data-center power project.

items.title: Constellation and Vistra Get the Headlines. These 2 Power Producers Barely Get Mentioned.
items.summary: Talen Energy and NRG Energy receive less attention than Constellation and Vistra, but both are expanding power capacity to meet AI data center demand.
